data.content_ref: inline:SRC_009's threshold-placement validity rule contradicts SRC_008's 'no new accepted attacker on a root' reduction: with bounded integer attack weights, SRC_009 guarantees committed-root validity iff τ strictly exceeds the weight of every attack edge incident to the root, while SRC_008's single load-bearing check is label-based and weight-blind. The causal mechanism diverges because enrichment among non-root nodes can flip a weight-<τ attacker to accepted in the grounded extension, so SRC_009's guarantee fails while SRC_008's check passes — the two foundations disagree on the same run. REFUTED IF there exists a weighted graph and an admissible enrichment where every attack edge incident to a committed root has weight < τ yet the root's validity flips to invalid, or where SRC_008's check certifies a run SRC_009's rule rejects.
